_comment: availability_from and availability_to are shifted forward by whole weeks at load time, relative to dates_anchored_to (shift_availability in api/mock_hygge.py); merchant_occupancy.json shifts the same way. Author the dates as if dates_anchored_to were today. Prices are per night in PLN; the five cabins mirror Osada Hygge's real lineup (Fika, Lagom, Gron, Hyggelig, Lykke).

products.title: Domek Fika — jacuzzi na tarasie
products.short_description: Fika means coffee in Swedish — a bright cabin with black accents and a private jacuzzi on the terrace, steps from the forest and lake.
products.long_description: Fika is the light-and-graphite one: warm oak floors, black steel details, floor-to-ceiling glass onto the pines, and a wood-fired jacuzzi on its own terrace. Fifty-six square metres sleep four in comfort — a downstairs bedroom and a snug mezzanine — with a full kitchen, underfloor heating, and a Smart TV for the slow evenings. The published rate is fully refundable up to 48 hours before arrival. Out the door: the Gostynin–Wloclawek forest for cycling and the lake a short walk away.
review_highlights: The terrace jacuzzi under the trees at dusk is the whole trip
Spotless, design-magazine pretty, and warm even on a cold weekend
Perfect forest quiet — we slept better here than we have in months

products.title: Domek Lagom — jacuzzi na tarasie
products.short_description: Lagom means 'just right' in Swedish — the original cabin, cosy and warm with gold-and-copper accents and a jacuzzi on the terrace.
products.long_description: Lagom was the first Osada Hygge cabin and still the sentimental favourite: warm, pale tones lifted with gold and copper, a deep sofa built for reading, and a private jacuzzi on the terrace facing the trees. Same fifty-six square metres and layout as Fika — sleeps four across a bedroom and mezzanine, full kitchen, underfloor heating — in a softer, warmer palette. Fully refundable up to 48 hours before arrival. Bikes, the lake, and the forest trails are all on the doorstep.
review_highlights: The copper-and-cream styling is gorgeous and the bed is a cloud
Jacuzzi + a bottle of wine + total silence = perfect anniversary
Felt instantly homey; we didn't want to leave on Sunday

products.title: Domek Gron
products.short_description: A charming, comfortable forest cabin near the lake — made for a cycling weekend, a hammock and a book, and easy space for kids to play.
products.long_description: Gron ('green') is the outdoors cabin: fifty-six square metres opening to a large, safe garden by the Gostynin–Wloclawek forest, with a hammock, a fire pit, and the lake a short ride away. Sleeps four across a bedroom and mezzanine, with a full kitchen and a big table for board-game nights. No hot tub here — this one's for hammock afternoons and campfire evenings. Fully refundable up to 48 hours before arrival.
review_highlights: Huge safe garden — the kids and dog were in heaven
Great base for cycling; the lake is a lovely short ride
Cosy inside, wild and green outside — exactly what we wanted

products.title: Domek Hyggelig
products.short_description: Hyggelig — Danish for 'cosy'. A warm, comfortable forest cabin near the lake, big on quiet and easy on the budget.
products.long_description: Hyggelig lives up to its name: fifty-four square metres of warm, unfussy comfort in the forest near the lake, made for slow mornings and long walks. Sleeps four across a bedroom and mezzanine, with a full kitchen and a covered terrace for coffee whatever the weather. No hot tub — the appeal here is the calm and the price. Fully refundable up to 48 hours before arrival.
review_highlights: Best value of the cabins — warm, quiet, and genuinely cosy
Loved the covered terrace; we sat out even in the rain
Simple and comfortable, exactly what a forest getaway should be

products.title: Domek Lykke
products.short_description: Lykke — Danish for 'happiness'. The newest and smallest cabin, a snug forest retreat sized for two.
products.long_description: Lykke is the intimate one: forty-five square metres of bright, modern calm added in 2023, sized for two and tucked into the forest near the lake. A comfortable double, a full kitchenette, and a terrace for morning coffee among the pines. No hot tub, no fuss — just a quiet, easy escape at the friendliest rate on the property. Fully refundable up to 48 hours before arrival.
review_highlights: Perfect little escape for two — snug, bright, and brand new
Great price for the Osada Hygge quiet and forest setting
Small but thought-through; everything you need for a weekend
